output.title: Ingress pathType change: environment lacks ACME HTTP-01 ingress details
output.content: The release note says the Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` changes from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact`. It does not say which cert-manager feature creates those Ingresses. The environment shows only apps/v1 Deployment, cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, and the CRD certificates.cert-manager.io [v1]. No Issuer, ClusterIssuer, Ingress, or Challenge resources or CRDs appear, and no values key configures an ingress or solver. The key global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole is set, but the excerpt does not link it to this change. To decide, check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses an ACME HTTP-01 ingress solver, which the supplied inputs do not show.
